archived.description: Boolean flag used to archive or unarchive a category (when set to true, account is not visible or usable on the platform)

code.description: The accounting system's internal identifier of the tax code

companyId.description: Company ID the tax code is being created/updated for

ingoingTaxAccount.description: Ingoing tax account usually used to account for reverse VAT

outgoingTaxAccount.description: Outgoing tax account usually used to account for reverse VAT

rate.description: Percentage rate applied for this tax code (This is represented in decimals and not the percentage. e.g. 20% tax rate would be 0.20)
